prompts.name: cottage
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: a single complete game sprite for a cute 2D top-down Korean Goryeo trade game.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing asset/design reference; image 2 is the Ninja Adventure building tilesheet CAMERA AND PIXEL-SCALE reference; image 3 is the team Venice/Arabia STYLE reference. Do not copy components out of the references.
Subject: a larger rural cottage with straw thatch, simple timber frame and plaster walls.
Primary request: redraw this one whole asset with its existing Korean identity, material colors and recognizable function. Change the camera to an ELEVATED top-down RPG view about 55-60 degrees downward: clearly expose a generous roof TOP PLANE with ridge and eaves, while preserving a readable front facade/entrance. Camera is centered on the facade, not a diagonal isometric view. The roof should occupy about half to two-thirds of the total sprite height. Do NOT merely shift the original flat front facade; reconstruct the roof volume and wall projection.
Style: polished economical PIXEL ART, crisp substantial pixel clusters, dark warm outline, only 2 or 3 broad shades per material, cheerful restrained colors. Plain surfaces; sparse structural lines. Same game/style as references, not painterly realism, 3D render, vector, noisy miniature illustration, or photograph.
Native target: 80x64 logical pixels, intended to fit the EXISTING footprint and bottom-center anchor. Design all structural features to survive at that size. Render with clean nearest-neighbor pixel blocks; simple clear silhouette. 
Composition: ONE fully visible complete asset centered with a small transparent safety margin, landscape aspect ratio approximately 80:64; no floor tile, environment, terrain, people, labels, grid, frame or watermark. Preserve actual alpha transparency around the object. No cut-off eaves, handles or bow.
Lighting: consistent upper-left light. Avoid excessive tiny roof lines and speckles. Native clarity is more important than detail.
